frozen_predictions.description: Under coarse C2 at beta=6.5, delete the second parallel rib from R3's nonlimiting Z step (C2+RX3, N=99,580, -27.1% qubits vs C2+R3=136,536) vs from R3's limiting X step (C2+RZ3, N=131,820).
Prune one of four bridge plaquettes in the coarse X step of all-compact C2C2 (C2pX+C2, N=24,086, K=1, -4.22% qubits below C2C2=25,148) at beta=6.5.

At planar beta=7.0, test whether RX3+C2 (N=116,164, removing 66.2% of R3+C2's extra qubits over C3+C2) retains R3+C2's cold coarse-bridge gain over C3+C2 and RZ3+C2 (note: flat 2D coarse i.i.d. model explicitly tests whether coarse size penalty or 3D coarse X-bridge cleaning dominates!).
